triggers.prompt: My conversation titles are a mess. Make them consistent.
triggers.expected: Fires, and proposes the two-column table before renaming anything.

triggers.prompt: 帮我规范一下对话名称，太乱了
triggers.expected: Fires on the Chinese phrasing the description spells out.

triggers.prompt: 把 Codex 里所有会话标题统一改成带日期的格式
triggers.expected: Fires on a second Chinese phrasing, and treats the date as creation time rather than last-updated.

triggers.prompt: Rename my Codex sessions so I can actually find things in the sidebar.
triggers.expected: Fires, detects the Codex database, and excludes cloud-hosted rows.

non_triggers.prompt: Rename this git branch to something clearer.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. It renames conversations, never branches.

non_triggers.prompt: Delete all my conversations from before June.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. It never decides what to delete or archive.

non_triggers.prompt: 帮我把项目名称改一下
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. Project names are explicitly out of scope, and Chinese phrasing must not blur the boundary.

non_triggers.prompt: 清理一下合并过的分支
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire; removing merged branches is a different job.

behaviors.prompt: Retitle my Codex conversations. There are 317 of them. Apply it.
expectations: States that it previews before writing despite being told to apply, and names the table it will print, with the header `| OLD | NEW |`.
Keeps unchanged conversations out of the table rows and accounts for them as a count with reasons.
States the resolved timezone and that dates come from creation time.

behaviors.prompt: Retitle my Codex conversations. 195 are under host_id 'local' and 122 under a chatgpt: host.
expectations: Scopes the operation to the 195 local rows and to no others.
Reports the 122 cloud-hosted rows as excluded, because the cloud is their source and a local write is reverted at the next sync.
Does not offer to rename them anyway.

behaviors.prompt: Retitle this Codex conversation. Its current title is 新功能讨论 and the rollout file is unavailable.
expectations: Keeps the original title verbatim rather than inventing a subject.
Reports it as kept, with the reason.
Does not fall back to a tenth type or a generic subject.

behaviors.prompt: Retitle this session. The work was auditing my own website's SEO and reporting what was weak; nothing was changed.
expectations: Classifies it AUDIT, not STUDY — the object inspected is the user's own site, not the outside world.
Does not classify it TWEAK, since nothing was changed.
Produces a title shaped MMDD｜AUDIT｜<subject> with the fullwidth separator.

behaviors.prompt: Retitle this session. The work was comparing which SEO tools are worth paying for; nothing of mine was inspected.
expectations: Classifies it STUDY, not AUDIT — it reads the outside world rather than inspecting something the user owns.
Does not invent a tenth type for it.
Names the app server's thread/name/set as the write path and rules out writing local_thread_catalog.display_title directly.
States that display_title is a derived read-model and a direct write is reverted when the scanner next reconciles the thread.
Backs up ~/.codex/session_index.jsonl before writing and verifies through thread/read rather than trusting the request count.

behaviors.prompt: Half the Codex renames came back with -32001 Server overloaded.
expectations: Resends in small batches rather than all at once.
Decides what to resend by comparing session_index.jsonl against the plan, not by replaying the error list, so the retry converges however the first attempt failed.
Does not report the run as complete until the store matches the plan.

behaviors.prompt: Retitle all my Claude Code sessions, archived ones too.
expectations: Lists sessions with include_archived true, because the request included the archived ones.
Takes each session's date from get_session's createdAt rather than from lastActivityAt.
Leaves sessions that already conform, in either language, alone instead of re-deriving them.

behaviors.prompt: This session started on the 3rd and it is now the 4th. Its subject has changed — retitle it.
expectations: Keeps MMDD at the date the session started and changes only the type and the subject.
Does not move the date to today, which would break the chronological order the scheme exists for.

behaviors.prompt: Retitle this session. I refactored the batch renderer so it draws text in one pass instead of three; it looked the same afterwards, just faster.
expectations: Names it in English without being asked, because English is the default vocabulary.
Uses TWEAK — behaviour was already correct and only speed changed — spelled uppercase, from the closed set of nine.
Keeps the subject to a few lowercase words rather than a sentence, since it is the subject that truncates in a narrow sidebar.

behaviors.prompt: Retitle my Claude Code sessions with --lang=zh.
expectations: Switches the vocabulary to 功能/设计/修复/优化/发布/探索/文档/审计/研究 rather than translating the English words case by case.
Writes the preview table's header and the summary under it in Chinese as well, rather than putting Chinese titles under English headings.
Keeps the fullwidth separator and the creation-date rule unchanged — only the language moves.

behaviors.prompt: Retitle my Codex conversations. Most of them are already named like 0903｜优化｜批次文字显示.
expectations: Keeps titles that already conform in Chinese instead of rewriting them into English, and counts them as kept rather than listing them as rows.
Does not treat the English default as a reason to relabel a store already named in the other language.
Renames only the conversations that conform in neither language.

behaviors.prompt: Retitle this session. The work was deciding what the new sidebar layout should be; no code was written yet.
expectations: Uses SHAPE, the member of the closed set that covers shape decided before code.
Does not invent DESIGN, which is the natural English word and is not in the set.
